well: ODP Hole 168-1027C, Juan de Fuca Ridge eastern flank, North Pacific (47.7565 N, -127.731 E; seafloor -2,656 m; crustal age 3.586 Ma) - a CORK (Circulation Obviation Retrofit Kit) SEALED-BOREHOLE OBSERVATORY: the real-world permanent downhole monitoring installation
operator_on_log: ODP Leg 168 (1996) drilling + CORK installation; thermistor-string measurements Davis & Becker (2002); multi-year service record in the file's own Comment block (data recoveries 1997/1999/2000, logger REPLACED 1999, status 'Operational (pressure only)')
source_database: PANGAEA, dataset doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.722627 ('(Appendix 1) Temperature measurements of CORK installation on ODP Hole 168-1027C'); supplement to Davis & Becker (2002), Earth Planet. Sci. Lett. 204, 231-248, doi:10.1016/S0012-821X(02)00982-2

coverage: COMPLETE DATASET: 10 thermistor stations, 0 -> 612.3 mbsf, TWO epochs at the same depths: 'installation' (1996, drilling-disturbed) and '1999' (after ~3 years sealed, near-equilibrium). The file's Comment block carries the full observatory service history AND the formation-pressure summary (initial -69 kPa -> equilibrium -26 kPa relative to hydrostatic: young crust slightly UNDERpressured).
science_disclosure: The two-epoch structure IS the entry's meaning: the drilling-disturbed state (2.5-19.6 degC) recovering to the natural state (17.5-60.7 degC) after three sealed years - the disturbed-vs-equilibrium distinction the KTB temperature entries could only DISCLOSE is here MEASURED on both sides. The sealed profile shows the Davis-Becker result: a steep conductive sediment gradient (~104 degC/km - young hot crust) collapsing to an ISOTHERMAL basement section (60.6-60.7 degC across 596.8-612.3 m) - vigorous hydrothermal circulation homogenizing the upper basement. Surface station has no installation-epoch value (blank in source, NaN here).
purpose: TWENTIETH catalogue entry - the thematic crown: a real PERMANENT DOWNHOLE OBSERVATORY (thirteenth kind, region TWELVE) - the physical instrument class this entire simulator package models (sealed borehole, multi-year monitoring, data recoveries, a logger replacement: the ServiceLifeSimulator's world as history), carrying the disturbed->equilibrium recovery the catalogue's honesty pins have pointed at since entry 12
